# Copilot instructions

[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) is binding for all work in this repository.

Read and follow it before suggesting or applying changes. Do not duplicate its rules here. If a request conflicts with it, stop and ask the maintainer.

Every pull request must include the **AGENTS.md compliance** statement from [`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md).
